In the output above:
The Moon Wikipedia text says:
`ranging from {{convert|357000|-|407000|km|mi|sp=us}}`
Wait, let's search the wikitext for "perigee" specifically in the infobox or orbital parameters table of the Moon article.
Let's run a script to pull the infobox parameters from the Moon article.```python
cmd = """curl -s -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)" "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon" | python3 -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); wt=list(data['query']['pages'].values())[0]['revisions'][0]['*']; [print(line) for line in wt.splitlines() if 'perigee' in line.lower() or 'apogee' in line.lower() or 'periapsis' in line.lower()]" """
out = await run_command(cmd)
print(out)
```
